# cloudsmith_repository_connected (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "my_organization" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

resource "cloudsmith_repository" "source" {
  description = "Source repository"
  name        = "source-repo"
  namespace   = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
}

resource "cloudsmith_repository" "target" {
  description = "Target repository"
  name        = "target-repo"
  namespace   = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
}

resource "cloudsmith_repository_connected" "link" {
  namespace         = cloudsmith_repository.source.namespace
  repository        = cloudsmith_repository.source.slug_perm
  target_repository = cloudsmith_repository.target.slug
  is_active         = true
  priority          = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Organization to which the source Repository belongs.
- `repository` (String) Source Repository from which to add the connection.
- `target_repository` (String) The slug of the target Repository to connect to.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the connection is active.
- `priority` (Number) Order in which connected repositories are checked (ascending, starting at 1). Ties are broken by age (oldest first).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date and time when the connection was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug_perm` (String) The immutable slug identifier of the connection.
